status: label + protocol + metrics + structural predictions. Detector hyperparameters may be tuned ONLY on validation seeds (30000-30049) with dev policies 0-9, then locked in freeze_v3 before any test-seed evaluation.

pnr_label.handoff_grid: every step in the last 60 steps before termination, every 5 steps before that

primary_fallback.name: F_nominal
primary_fallback.controller: bang-bang on the LQR gain of the Euler-discretised linearised cartpole with NOMINAL parameters

pnr_label.sensitivity_fallback: F_informed: same design with the true shifted parameters
pnr_label.rollout_rng: np.random.default_rng([11, policy_seed, env_seed, condition_index_in_freeze_v1_list]); retest uses first element 12
pnr_label.t_pnr: last handoff step with p_recover >= thr; episodes with none: PNR undefined (counted as not alarm-able, reported)
pnr_label.fixed_lead_sensitivity: alarm at or before T_fail - 10 steps

label_validity.rule: a condition is label-valid if the always-on fallback fails < 10% of design episodes at eps 0.02 (proto_always_fallback.csv, seeds 10000-10019), for BOTH fallbacks
label_validity.headline: valid conditions only; flagged conditions reported separately with the failure-only label

intervention: no detector-gated benefit claims; report the always-on F_nominal failure rate per condition as the reference gated intervention cannot beat (the fallback has no cost in CartPole)

partitions_added.note: nominal only; calibration_threshold is new and disjoint from all earlier blocks; models never see shifted data

detectors.D1_forward_residual: degree-2 polynomial ridge (alpha 1e-6, standardised inputs) predicting next-state delta from (state, action), per policy, fit on calibration_fit; score = windowed mean squared standardised residual
detectors.D2_policy_confidence: 1 - max action probability of the policy
detectors.D3_isolation_forest: sklearn IsolationForest(n_estimators=100, random_state=0) on the last 5 states flattened, per policy, fit on calibration_fit windows; score = -score_samples
detectors.threshold: per policy and detector: (1-alpha) quantile (higher interpolation) of the per-episode maximum score over calibration_threshold
detectors.alarm: first step t >= window-1 with smoothed score > threshold (score smoothing = mean over the last 5 steps)
detectors.stored: first-alarm step per detector and alpha, per-episode max score

metrics.unit: policy; statistics computed per policy, then averaged over policies; 95% percentile bootstrap over policies (10000 resamples, numpy seed 0)
metrics.onset_rate: fraction of a policy's episodes (pooled over a class's conditions) with any alarm; onset = step 0 (static shifts)
metrics.timely_recall: among failing episodes in label-valid conditions: fraction with first alarm <= t_PNR; undefined PNR counts as not timely; policies with < 3 failing episodes in the class are excluded and counted
metrics.irrelevant_alarm_share: among episodes with any alarm: fraction that do not fail
metrics.nominal_check: report per-policy alarm rate on nominal validation/test episodes next to the calibration alpha

preregistered_added.P4_harmless_alarms: CONTROL class (pooled over its 7 conditions), alpha=0.05, mean over the 20 test policies of onset_rate. Precondition: pooled CONTROL failure rate <= 0.05 on the test policies, else inconclusive. Supported if >= 2 of the 4 detectors have mean onset_rate >= 0.50; refuted if none does; otherwise inconclusive.
preregistered_added.P5_trivial_baseline: FAST fold, label-valid conditions, alpha=0.05, timely_recall. Needs >= 8 of 20 test policies contributing, else inconclusive. Supported if D0 (margin) mean timely_recall >= 0.80 AND no other detector exceeds D0 by >= 0.10 with a 95% policy-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0. Refuted if some detector exceeds D0 by >= 0.10 with CI lower bound > 0. Otherwise inconclusive.
preregistered_added.P6_policy_heterogeneity: D1 (forward residual), alpha=0.05, FAST fold, label-valid conditions: range (max - min) over contributing test policies (>= 8) of per-policy timely_recall. Supported if >= 0.30; refuted if < 0.15; otherwise inconclusive.
